# My Bifrost App

An app built on Bifrost Foundation. It reads items: one item's price and inventory, or a
capped list of items.

## Message types
| Type | Effect | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MyApp.Hello.Get` | Read-only | Hello World: greeting, user, company and app version. Call it first. |
| `MyApp.Item.Summary.Get` | Read-only | One item's description, base unit, unit price and inventory as of a date. |
| `MyApp.Item.List` | Read-only | Items by number filter, at most 100 rows, with the total count. |
| `Help.MyApp.Get` | Read-only | This overview. |

For the contract of any one type, call `Help.Implementation.Get` with its name.
